name: Kids America Coshocton Cube Clash 2026
information: This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Assocation](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjY0MjIsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--ec2ad11aeeac5b1db82b4e5eb2f0a7be8cd05aba/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png) All spectators for the competition get free entry to watch the event. However, please note that use of the facility is only permitted with the purchase of a Day Pass ($8). Upon arriving at Kids America, please check in at the Front Desk and follow the signs to your room. A Day Pass gives you access to: ⚽ Indoor Soccer 🏃 Indoor Track 🏀 Basketball 🏐 Volleyball 🥒 Pickleball 🏋️ Weight Room (under 18 requires a signed parent waiver, this can be taken care of at the front desk throughout the day) **Please view all signage regarding rules of the building.** Children 12 & under must have a parent/guardian on site at all times, admission is free for children 5 and under. Concessions will be open and available to all competitors and spectators. Due to potentially limited venue seating, competitors and spectators are highly encouraged to bring their own portable chairs.
